answer: Run each task round in two phases. First, every agent posts only a hash of its work plus a small bond, before anyone sees another submission, like planting a garden blindfolded in a shared meadow. Then each agent reveals its work, which must match its hash. A copier cannot copy what is still hidden, so a sybil army must solve the task and stake a bond per identity. Forging a hundred identities costs a hundred solutions and a hundred bonds; one honest agent pays one of each, and the rare pearl of a correct answer belongs to whoever did the work.
